discriminating_terms: solid and dashed lines correspond to observed and predicted values
examples.rationale: The paired subject and object lists are explicitly mapped in order: solid line to observed value and dashed line to predicted value. A merely separate or distributive reading would not express this first-to-first correspondence, so sense:001 is the only natural candidate.

discriminating_terms: checked the text and prepared the layout
examples.rationale: The two subjects are paired with two different subject-predicate frames in order: the editor checked the text and the designer prepared the layout. A non-ordered 'each/separately' reading would not specify that cross-list mapping, so sense:001 is the only natural candidate.

The result states first and second are assigned to Brazil and Canada in that order. A merely distributive reading would not encode the country-to-rank pairing, so sense:001 is the only natural candidate.

discriminating_terms: x and y respectively represent distance and time
examples.rationale: The representation relation pairs x with distance and y with time in sequence. A reading meaning only that the variables represent values individually would omit the required ordered correspondence, so sense:001 is the only natural candidate.
The age predicates assign 18 to Mia and 21 to Leo in order. A merely individual or separate reading would not identify which age belongs to which person, so sense:001 is the only natural candidate.

discriminating_terms: lower and higher rates apply to part-time and full-time employees
examples.rationale: The apply-to relation maps the lower rate to part-time employees and the higher rate to full-time employees in order. A non-ordered distributive reading would not determine those rate-category pairings, so sense:001 is the only natural candidate.

discriminating_terms: two stores had sales of $2 million and $1.4 million
examples.rationale: The possession/measurement frame assigns the first sales amount to the first store and the second amount to the second store. A merely separate reading would not preserve that ordered store-to-amount relation, so sense:001 is the only natural candidate.
